title: Co-occurrence of rapid motion and close proximity as a proxy for Drosophila male aggression
description: Analysis and preprocessing code for the Aggression-Associated Frame Ratio (AAFR), a recording-level measure that quantifies the proportion of valid video frames in which high frame-to-frame image change (ΔI) and short inter-fly distance (Dₜ) occur simultaneously in pairs of male Drosophila melanogaster. AAFR does not classify individual behavioral actions. This repository accompanies the manuscript "Co-occurrence of rapid motion and close proximity as a proxy for Drosophila male aggression".
